turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files describing perovskite solar cells as
complete devices — `substrate` (glass + transparent electrode), `etl`
(electron-transport layer stack), `htl` (hole-transport layer stack),
`backcontact` (metal / carbon back electrode), `deposition` (absorber
deposition procedure; `>>` separates steps). Every candidate below uses the
same MAPbI3 absorber in the same p-i-n (inverted) architecture; they differ
only in the remaining columns. Each row is a device CONFIGURATION whose
efficiency is the median over at least 3 independently fabricated cells, so
it is a reproducible recipe rather than a single champion cell:
  - b3_pvk_stack_pin_train.csv: 300 configurations with the measured power
    conversion efficiency (%).
  - b3_pvk_stack_pin_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE configurations whose power
    conversion efficiency (%) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same device columns.

Using the training data, select the 5 candidates with the HIGHEST power
conversion efficiency (%).

Reason from the device physics — band alignment and selectivity of the
transport layers, interface recombination, contact chemistry and the film
quality the process is likely to give — then end your answer with an
explicit ranked list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902,
c903, c904, c905".
turns.answer_text:
I'll systematically analyze the training data to identify the key device physics principles, then apply them to rank the candidates.

## Step 1: Extract Patterns from Training Data

### Key observations from high-efficiency devices (>18%):

| PCE | ETL | HTL | Back contact | Deposition |
|-----|-----|-----|--------------|------------|
| 24.8 | PCBM-60 \| TmPyPB | PEDOT:PSS | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 21.33 | PCBM-60 \| [BMIM]BF4 | NiO-c | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 20.0 | PCBM-60 | Au-np \| NiO-c | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 19.7 | Choline chloride \| C60 \| BCP | NiO-np | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 19.48 | PCBM-60 \| Bphen | PTAA \| PMMA | Al | Spin-coating |
| 19.27 | PCBM-60; F8TBT | PEDOT:PSS | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 19.085 | C60 \| BCP | PTAA | Cu | Slot-die coating |
| 19.04 | PCBM-60 \| BCP | NiO-c \| SDBS | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.98 | PCBM-60 \| C60 \| BCP | P3CT-Na \| PASP | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.95 | PCBM-60 \| Zr(acac)4 | PolyTPD | Ag | Spin-coating >> CBD |
| 18.85 | PCBM-60 \| C60 \| BCP | PTAA | Cu | Spin-coating |
| 18.8 | PCBM-60 \| BCP | PTAA \| PFN | Cu \| Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.62 | C60 \| BCP | PTAA | Cu | Spin-coating >> Spin-coating |
| 18.49 | ITCPTC-Th \| C60 \| BCP | P3CT-Na | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.41 | PCBM-60 \| Rhodamine 101 \| LiF | PEDOT:PSS \| PTAA | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.4 | C60 \| BCP | none | Cu | Doctor blading |
| 18.185 | PCBM-60 \| TiO2-c | NiMgLiO-c | Ag | Spin-coating |
| 18.16 | C60 \| BCP | DBFMT | Ag | Spin-coating >> Spin-coating |
| 18.115 | PCBM-60 \| BCP | NiO-c | Au | Spin-coating >> Spin-coating |
| 18.08 | PCBM-60 \| Bphen | PTAA | Al | Spin-coating |
| 18.0 | C60 \| BCP | MoO3 \| TaTm | Ag | Co-evaporation |

### Device physics principles distilled:

**ETL side (electron extraction, p-i-n = light enters through HTL):**
- Fullerene-based ETLs (C60, PCBM-60, PCBM-70) dominate high performers
- Interlayer modifiers dramatically boost performance: BCP, Bphen (exciton/electron blocking, reduces recombination at ETL/metal interface), Zr(acac)4 (passivates fullerene/perovskite interface), TmPyPB, [BMIM]BF4, Rhodamine 101 (dipole/interface passivation), LiF (work function tuning), C60 multilayers
- The ETL modifier pattern: primary fullerene + interface modifier = best results
- C60 \| BCP and PCBM-60 \| BCP are the most reliable high-efficiency combinations
- PCBM-60 \| Zr(acac)4 reaches 16.04–18.95% depending on HTL
- PCBM-60 \| Bphen reaches 13.18–19.48%
- ITCPTC-Th \| C60 \| BCP reaches 18.49%

**HTL side (hole extraction):**
- PTAA is the premier HTL: appears in 17–19%+ devices consistently
  - PTAA alone: 17.17%, 16.9%, 15.4%, 14.38%...
  - PTAA \| PMMA: 19.48%
  - PTAA \| PFN: 18.8%
  - NiO-c \| PTAA: 17.255%
- NiO-c is strong: 13.2–21.33% range
- P3CT-Na is excellent: 16.4–18.49%
- PolyTPD: 14.5–18.95%
- PEDOT:PSS: widely used but typically 10–17% range
- NiO-np: 14.845–17.815%

**Back contact:**
- Cu: excellent ohmic contact with PTAA, appears in 18–19%+ devices
- Ag: most common, works well across all HTLs
- Au: good but less common
- Al: works but lower work function mismatch issues

**Substrate:** SLG \| ITO dominates high performers

**Deposition:** Spin-coating is standard; CBD (chemical bath deposition) as second step sometimes helps crystallinity

### Statistical summary of ETL modifier impact:
- `C60 | BCP` + PTAA + Cu/Ag: 17–19%
- `PCBM-60 | BCP` + PTAA + Ag/Cu: 16–18.8%
- `PCBM-60 | Bphen` + PTAA: 18.08%
- `PCBM-60 | Zr(acac)4` + PolyTPD: 18.95%
- `PCBM-60 | C60 | BCP` + PTAA + Cu: 18.85%
- `ITCPTC-Th | C60 | BCP` + P3CT-Na: 18.49%

## Step 2: Evaluate Each Candidate

Let me go through all 100 candidates systematically, focusing on device physics:

**c000**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|AZO, PEDOT:PSS, Al, Doctor blading
- AZO as ETL modifier: seen in training at 11.0% (PCBM-60\|AZO + NiO-c). AZO is a metal oxide, not ideal as ETL interlayer. PEDOT:PSS HTL, Al contact, doctor blading. Moderate ~11-14%

**c001**: PI\|Ag-np\|PEDOT:PSS substrate, PCBM-60\|PEI, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Unusual flexible substrate. PEI modifier seen at 12.03% (PCBM-60\|PEI + PEDOT:PSS + Al). PEDOT:PSS HTL. Moderate ~12-13%

**c002**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Alq3, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Alq3 as ETL modifier: not seen in training. Alq3 is an electron transport material (OLED), could work as interlayer. PEDOT:PSS HTL. Uncertain, moderate ~12-14%

**c003**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60, TBASBP, Al
- TBASBP as HTL: not seen in training. Unknown HTL. Al contact. Low-moderate ~10-13%

**c004**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60\|BCP, NiMgO-c, Ag
- PCBM-60\|BCP is excellent ETL. NiMgO-c: similar to NiMgLiO seen at 18.185% (with TiO2-c ETL) and 10.105% (LiMgNiO). NiMgO-c is a doped NiO, good HTL. FTO substrate. Training shows PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c + Ag reaching 14.94–19.04%. NiMgO-c should be comparable to NiO-c. Estimate ~15-18%

**c005**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, PTCBI\|Ag\|WO3\|PTCBI\|Ag
- Complex back contact stack. PCBM-60 alone + PEDOT:PSS. Unusual back contact. ~9-12%

**c006**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Bphen, GeO2, Ag
- PCBM-60\|Bphen is a strong ETL combination (13.18–19.48% in training). GeO2 as HTL: seen in training at 13.18% (PCBM-60\|Bphen + PEDOT:PSS\|GeO2). GeO2 alone as HTL is less established than PEDOT:PSS. Estimate ~13-15%

**c007**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|TrNBr, PTAA, Ag
- TrNBr as ETL modifier: not seen in training. PTAA is excellent HTL. TrNBr (trimethylammonium bromide derivative?) could be an ionic modifier. PTAA + Ag is a strong combination. Estimate ~15-18%

**c008**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|LiF, PCDTBT, Ag
- PCBM-60\|LiF seen at 12.17% (PEDOT:PSS), 11.0% (NiO-np), 13.1% (Spiro-MeOTAD). PCDTBT as HTL: seen in training at 8.23% (NiO-c\|PCDTBT). PCDTBT is a conjugated polymer HTL, moderate performance. ~12-14%

**c009**: SLG\|ITO, C60\|BCP, NiO-c, Ag
- C60\|BCP + NiO-c + Ag: directly in training at 14.3% (Al contact) and 13.2% (Spin-coating >> Gas reaction). With Ag and standard spin-coating: ~14.3%. Also 14.8% (Au contact, co-evaporation). Estimate ~14-15%

**c010**: SLG\|ITO, C60, PTAA, Ag
- C60 alone (no BCP): seen at 7.65% (PEDOT:PSS, Al). C60 without BCP modifier is weaker. PTAA is excellent HTL. The lack of BCP means more recombination at ETL/metal interface. Estimate ~14-16% (PTAA compensates somewhat)

**c011**: SLG\|Ag-nw;Graphene oxide, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Non-standard substrate. PCBM-60 + PEDOT:PSS + Ag. Moderate ~9-12%

**c012**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, PEDOT:PSS\|PolyTPD, Au
- PCBM-60\|BCP excellent ETL. PEDOT:PSS\|PolyTPD bilayer HTL. Training: PCBM-60\|BCP + PEDOT:PSS + Al = 12.7% (PLD), 12.0% (spin). Au contact. PolyTPD addition to PEDOT:PSS could help. Estimate ~14-16%

**c013**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Rhodamine 101, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Rhodamine 101 modifier: seen at 7.61% (NiO-c, Au\|Ag), 9.41% (NiO-c, Ag). With PEDOT:PSS: training shows 13.14% (PEDOT:PSS\|Au@SiO2-np). Estimate ~13-15%

**c014**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-70\|BCP, NiO-c, Ag
- PCBM-70\|BCP: seen at 11.12% (PEDOT:PSS). NiO-c is better HTL than PEDOT:PSS. PCBM-70 has slightly different energy levels than PCBM-60. Estimate ~14-16%

**c015**: SLG\|FTO, Zr(acac)4, PEDOT:PSS, Au, Spin-coating>>CBD
- Zr(acac)4 alone as ETL (not as modifier): unusual. Training shows Zr(acac)4 always as modifier on PCBM-60. As standalone ETL, uncertain. PEDOT:PSS HTL, Au contact. ~8-12%

**c016**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|PN4N, PEDOT:PSS, Al
- PN4N modifier: seen at 11.47% (FTO, NiO-c, Ag). With PEDOT:PSS and Al: likely lower. ~10-13%

**c017**: PET\|ITO, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Flexible substrate. Training: PET\|ITO + PCBM-60 + PEDOT:PSS + Ag = not directly, but PET\|ITO + C60\|BCP + PEDOT:PSS + Ag = 8.85%. PCBM-60 alone + PEDOT:PSS on PET: ~8-11%

**c018**: Textile\|PEN\|ITO, SnO2-c\|PCBM-60, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- Unusual substrate. SnO2-c\|PCBM-60 ETL stack. Spiro-MeOTAD HTL. This is more n-i-p like architecture on unusual substrate. ~10-14%

**c019**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60\|PEI, CuI, Ag
- PEI modifier: seen at 9.55% (NiO-c, Ag, doctor blading), 12.03% (PEDOT:PSS, Al). CuI as HTL: not seen in training. CuI is a p-type semiconductor, decent HTL. ~12-14%

**c020**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, MFGO, Ag
- PCBM-60\|BCP excellent ETL. MFGO (modified graphene oxide) as HTL: not seen in training. Graphene oxide HTL seen at 8.65% (C60\|BCP + GO + Au), 13.4% (PCBM-60\|BCP + GO). MFGO likely similar or better than GO. Estimate ~13-16%

**c021**: SLG\|FTO, C60-BPy\|BCP, NiO-c, Ag
- C60-BPy is a functionalized C60 with bipyridyl group. BCP modifier. NiO-c HTL. FTO substrate. Similar to C60-HPy\|BCP + NiO-c = 14.55% in training. C60-BPy should be comparable. Estimate ~14-16%

**c022**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|PEI, VB-MeO-FDPA, Ag
- PEI modifier. VB-MeO-FDPA as HTL: not seen in training. Likely a small molecule HTL. ~12-15%

**c023**: SLG\|ITO, PFPDI, P3CT, Ag
- PFPDI as ETL: perylene diimide derivative, seen as ETL in some perovskite work. P3CT as HTL: P3CT-Na seen at 16.4–18.49%. P3CT (without Na) may be similar. Estimate ~14-17%

**c024**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Au, Spin-coating>>Spin-coating
- PCBM-60\|BCP + PEDOT:PSS + Au: training shows PCBM-60\|BCP + PEDOT:PSS + Ag = 11.9%, Al = 12.0-12.7%. Au contact with PEDOT:PSS: ~12-14%

**c025**: NOA63\|Au substrate, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, MoO3\|Au\|Ag\|MoO3\|Alq3
- Very unusual substrate and back contact. Semitransparent device? Low efficiency expected. ~8-12%

**c026**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|PEIE, PEDOT:PSS, Au
- PEIE modifier: seen at 7.61% (PEDOT:PSS, Ag), 12.1% (PEDOT:PSS, Al), 12.3% (PEDOT:PSS, Ag, electrospraying), 11.64% (NiO-c, Cu). With Au contact: ~12-14%

**c027**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Rhodamine 101\|C60\|BCP\|Rhodamine 101\|LiF, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Very complex ETL stack with multiple modifiers. Training: PCBM-60\|Rhodamine 101\|LiF + PEDOT:PSS\|PTAA = 18.41%. This has C60\|BCP in the middle too. Could be very high. Estimate ~16-19%

**c028**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|ZnO-np, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- ZnO-np modifier: seen at 5.705% (PEDOT:PSS, Ag-nw), 9.6% (PEDOT:PSS, Al). With Ag: ~10-12%

**c029**: PET\|ITO, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, Ag, Slot-die coating
- Flexible, slot-die. ~8-11%

**c030**: SLG\|ITO, IDTT2FPDI\|PCBM-60\|Bphen, PTAA\|PMMA, Al
- IDTT2FPDI is a non-fullerene acceptor used as ETL. PCBM-60\|Bphen on top. PTAA\|PMMA HTL: seen at 19.48% (PCBM-60\|Bphen + PTAA\|PMMA + Al). This is very similar to that 19.48% device but with IDTT2FPDI added. The extra NFA layer could help or hurt. Estimate ~17-20%

**c031**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Ag-np\|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Ag-np in ETL stack: plasmonic enhancement. BCP present. PEDOT:PSS HTL. Estimate ~13-16%

**c032**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, Ag-nw\|ZnO-np
- PCBM-60 + PEDOT:PSS + Ag-nw\|ZnO-np back contact. Unusual back contact. ~10-13%

**c033**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Au
- PCBM-60\|BCP + PEDOT:PSS + Au: training shows similar with Ag = 11.9%, Al = 12.0-12.7%. Au is better work function match than Al for PEDOT:PSS. ~13-15%

**c034**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|C60\|BCP, PTAA, Al
- PCBM-60\|C60\|BCP: seen at 17.5% (P3CT-N, Ag), 18.85% (PTAA, Cu). With PTAA and Al: Al is not ideal for PTAA (work function mismatch). Training: PCBM-60\|C60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu = 18.85%. Al instead of Cu: lower. Estimate ~16-18%

**c035**: SLG\|FTO, TEAI\|PCBM-60\|PEI, NiO-c, Ag
- TEAI (tetraethylammonium iodide) as interface modifier before PCBM-60, then PEI. NiO-c HTL. Training: TEACl\|PCBM-60\|PEI + NiO-c = 15.265%. TEAI vs TEACl: similar ionic modifier. Estimate ~15-17%

**c036**: SLG\|ITO, pSNT, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- pSNT as ETL: not seen in training. Novel polymer ETL. PEDOT:PSS HTL. Uncertain. ~10-14%

**c037**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Bphen, PEDOT:PSS\|V2O5, Ag
- PCBM-60\|Bphen + PEDOT:PSS\|V2O5: training shows PCBM-60\|Bphen + V2O5 = 11.585%, PCBM-60\|Bphen + PEDOT:PSS\|CrO3 = 13.71%. V2O5 in HTL: ~13-15%

**c038**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|PEI, Au-np\|NiO-c, Ag
- PEI modifier. Au-np\|NiO-c HTL: training shows PCBM-60 + Au-np\|NiO-c = 20.0%! But that had no PEI. With PEI modifier: could be similar or slightly different. Estimate ~18-21%

**c039**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60\|TiO2-c, NiO-c, Ag
- PCBM-60\|TiO2-c + NiO-c: training shows PCBM-60\|TiO2-c + NiO-c + Ag = 17.4% (ITO). With FTO: similar. Estimate ~16-18%

**c040**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|TPBi, PEDOT:PSS, Al
- TPBi as ETL modifier: not seen in training. TPBi is an electron transport material (OLED). PEDOT:PSS HTL, Al contact. ~12-15%

**c041**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60\|BCP, NiMgLiO-c, Ag
- PCBM-60\|BCP + NiMgLiO-c: training shows PCBM-60\|TiO2-c + NiMgLiO-c = 18.185%. NiMgLiO-c is a high-quality HTL. PCBM-60\|BCP is excellent ETL. FTO substrate. Estimate ~17-19%

**c042**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|LiF, PEDOT:PSS\|PCDTBT, Ag, Co-evaporation
- LiF modifier. PEDOT:PSS\|PCDTBT bilayer HTL. Co-evaporation deposition. Training: PCBM-60\|LiF + PEDOT:PSS = 12.17%. PCDTBT addition may help slightly. ~12-14%

**c043**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Bphen, CuO-nw\|PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- PCBM-60\|Bphen + CuO-nw\|PEDOT:PSS: training shows PCBM-60\|Bphen + PEDOT:PSS = 13.805%. CuO-nw addition to PEDOT:PSS: ~13-15%

**c044**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, PTAA, Cu
- PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu: training shows C60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu = 18.62%, 19.085%. PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu\|Ag = 18.8%. This is essentially the same as 18.8% device. Estimate ~18-19%

**c045**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, CA-Br;TPA-PT-C6, Ag
- PCBM-60\|BCP + mixed HTL (CA-Br; TPA-PT-C6): not seen in training. Novel HTL blend. ~14-17%

**c046**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, DA-PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- PCBM-60\|BCP + DA-PEDOT:PSS (dopamine-modified PEDOT:PSS): not seen in training. Modified PEDOT:PSS could improve hole extraction. ~13-16%

**c047**: SLG\|ITO, C60\|BCP, Polythiophene, Ag, Spin-coating>>CBD
- C60\|BCP + Polythiophene HTL: not seen in training. Polythiophene (P3HT-like) as HTL. ~12-15%

**c048**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60, Cu0.67Cr0.33O2, Ag
- Cu0.67Cr0.33O2 as HTL: similar to CuCrO2 seen at 12.5% (FTO, PCBM-60\|BCP). Without BCP modifier: lower. ~11-14%

**c049**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-70\|AZO, PEDOT:PSS, Al
- PCBM-70\|AZO + PEDOT:PSS + Al: AZO modifier, PEDOT:PSS HTL. ~10-13%

**c050**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, NiO-mp, Ag, Spin-coating>>Spin-coating
- PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-mp: NiO-mp (mesoporous) not seen directly. NiO-np seen at 17.815% (C60\|BCP). NiO-mp may be similar. Estimate ~15-17%

**c051**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|BCP, NiO-c\|NiO-nw, Ag, Spin-coating>>Spin-coating
- PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c\|NiO-nw bilayer: NiO-c alone with PCBM-60\|BCP = 14.94–19.04%. NiO-nw addition could improve morphology. Estimate ~16-18%

**c052**: SLG\|FTO, PCBM-60\|Bphen, NiO-c, Ag
- PCBM-60\|Bphen + NiO-c + Ag + FTO: training shows C60-HPy\|BCP + NiO-c = 14.55%, PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c = 14.94–19.04%. Bphen vs BCP: similar function. FTO substrate. Estimate ~15-17%

**c053**: PET\|ITO, c-HATNA\|bis-C60, c-TCTA, Ag
- Directly in training: PET\|ITO + c-HATNA\|bis-C60 + c-TCTA + Ag = 13.29%. Estimate ~13.29%

**c054**: PET\|ITO, PCBM-60\|TIPD, PEDOT:PSS\|NiO-c, Al
- TIPD modifier: not seen in training. Flexible substrate. PEDOT:PSS\|NiO-c bilayer HTL. ~12-15%

**c055**: PET\|PEDOT:PSS, PCBM-60\|TiO2, PEDOT:PSS\|PEDOT:PSS, Al
- Unusual flexible substrate with PEDOT:PSS. ~8-12%

**c056**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|ZnO-np, P3CT-K, Al
- ZnO-np modifier + P3CT-K HTL: training shows PCBM-60\|ZnO + P3CT-K = 16.695%. This is essentially the same! Estimate ~16.7%

**c057**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|bis-C60, CuSCN, Ag
- bis-C60 modifier + CuSCN HTL: training shows PCBM-60\|LiF + CuSCN = 12.4%. bis-C60 is a better modifier. CuSCN is a decent HTL. Estimate ~13-16%

**c058**: SLG\|ITO, C60;PDI\|BCP, P3CT-Na, Ag
- C60;PDI blend + BCP + P3CT-Na: training shows ITCPTC-Th\|C60\|BCP + P3CT-Na = 18.49%. PDI-based ETL with C60 and BCP. P3CT-Na is excellent. Estimate ~16-19%

- Standard n-i-p architecture on FTO. Training: TiO2-c\|TiO2-mp + Spiro-MeOTAD + Ag-nw = 4.32%. With Au: ~4-8%. This is n-i-p, not optimized for p-i-n.

**c060**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|Zr(acac)4, NiO-np, Au
- PCBM-60\|Zr(acac)4 + NiO-np + Au: training shows PCBM-60\|Zr(acac)4 + NiO-c + Ag = 16.965%, + NiO-c + Al = 16.04%, + PolyTPD + Ag = 18.95%. NiO-np with Au: ~15-17%

**c062**: SLG\|ITO, Phenyltrichlorosilane\|PCBM-60, PEDOT:PSS, Ca\|Al
- PTS as interface modifier before PCBM-60. PEDOT:PSS HTL. Ca\|Al contact: training shows Ca\|Al = 10.575%, 11.82%. ~12-14%

**c063**: SLG\|ITO, ITCPTC-Se\|Rhodamine 101\|LiF, P3CT-Na, Ag
- ITCPTC-Se (selenium analog of ITCPTC-Th) + Rhodamine 101\|LiF + P3CT-Na: training shows ITCPTC-Th\|Rhodamine 101\|LiF + P3CT-Na = 16.41%, ITCPTC-Th\|C60\|BCP + P3CT-Na = 18.49%. Se analog may be similar or slightly different. Estimate ~16-18%

- C60\|PEI + PTAA + Ag: C60 with PEI modifier (not BCP). PTAA is excellent. PEI is an n-type interlayer. Training: C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag = 17.17%. PEI vs BCP: PEI is also effective. Estimate ~15-18%

**c065**: SLG\|FTO, SFX-PDI4\|TiO2-c, NiMgLiO-c, Ag
- SFX-PDI4 (spiro-fluorene PDI) + TiO2-c + NiMgLiO-c: training shows PCBM-60\|TiO2-c + NiMgLiO-c = 18.185%. SFX-PDI4 is a non-fullerene ETL. NiMgLiO-c is excellent. Estimate ~15-18%

**c066**: SLG\|FTO, TEABr\|PCBM-60\|PEI, NiO-c, Ag
- TEABr (tetraethylammonium bromide) + PCBM-60\|PEI + NiO-c: training shows TEACl\|PCBM-60\|PEI + NiO-c = 15.265%. TEABr vs TEACl: similar. Estimate ~15-17%

**c067**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60, Lignosulfonate;PEDOT:PSS;PDA, Al
- PCBM-60 + complex HTL blend + Al. ~10-13%

**c068**: SLG\|ITO, none, PEDOT:PSS, Liq\|Al
- No ETL. PEDOT:PSS HTL. Liq\|Al contact. Training: none ETL + PEDOT:PSS + Liq\|Al not seen. ~8-12%

**c069**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-60\|AZO-np, PTAA, Ag, Spin-coating>>Spin-coating
- PCBM-60\|AZO-np + PTAA + Ag: training shows PCBM-60\|AZO-np + PEDOT:PSS = 14.53%, + NiO-c = 13.52%. With PTAA (better HTL): estimate ~16-18%

**c070**: SLG\|ITO, PCBM-70, NiO-c\|FDA, AgAl
- PCBM-70 + NiO-c\|FDA + AgAl: FDA as HTL additive. ~13-16%

## Step 3: Top Candidate Ranking

Let me now rank the most promising candidates:

### Tier 1 (estimated >18%):

**c038**: PCBM-60\|PEI + Au-np\|NiO-c + Ag
- The training data shows PCBM-60 + Au-np\|NiO-c + Ag = **20.0%**. Adding PEI as an ETL modifier (which improves electron extraction and reduces recombination at the PCBM-60/perovskite interface) should maintain or improve this. PEI creates a dipole that lowers the work function of PCBM-60, improving electron selectivity. The Au-np\|NiO-c HTL provides plasmonic enhancement + good hole extraction. **Estimated: ~19-21%**

**c044**: PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu
- Training: PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu\|Ag = 18.8%, C60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu = 18.62–19.085%. PCBM-60\|BCP is slightly different from C60\|BCP but comparable. Cu back contact with PTAA is optimal. **Estimated: ~18-19%**

**c079**: PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c\|SY1 + Ag
- Training: PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c\|SDBS = 19.04%, PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c\|SY4 = 17.42%. SY1 is likely another surfactant modifier for NiO-c surface. SDBS (sodium dodecylbenzenesulfonate) is a surfactant that passivates NiO-c surface defects. SY1 likely similar function. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

**c085**: TTC\|C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag
- C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag = 17.17% in training. TTC as a self-assembled monolayer modifier at the perovskite/C60 interface would passivate traps and improve band alignment. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

**c030**: IDTT2FPDI\|PCBM-60\|Bphen + PTAA\|PMMA + Al
- Training: PCBM-60\|Bphen + PTAA\|PMMA + Al = 19.48%. Adding IDTT2FPDI (a non-fullerene acceptor) before PCBM-60 could improve light harvesting and charge extraction. However, it could also introduce additional recombination. The PTAA\|PMMA HTL is proven excellent. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

**c041**: PCBM-60\|BCP + NiMgLiO-c + Ag (FTO)
- Training: PCBM-60\|TiO2-c + NiMgLiO-c + Ag = 18.185%. PCBM-60\|BCP is a better ETL than PCBM-60\|TiO2-c for p-i-n. NiMgLiO-c is an excellent HTL. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

**c097**: ITCPTC-Se\|C60\|BCP + P3CT-Na + Ag
- Training: ITCPTC-Th\|C60\|BCP + P3CT-Na = 18.49%. Se analog of ITCPTC-Th: selenium substitution typically red-shifts absorption and may improve charge transport. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

**c088**: C60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu (Willow glass, doctor blading)
- Training: C60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu = 18.62% (spin), 19.085% (slot-die). Doctor blading: C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag = 16.9%. Willow glass is flexible but high quality. Cu contact is optimal. **Estimated: ~17-19%**

### Refined ranking based on device physics:

**1. c038** (PCBM-60\|PEI + Au-np\|NiO-c + Ag):
- The Au-np\|NiO-c HTL is the single highest-performing HTL in the training set (20.0%). PEI as ETL modifier is well-established for improving electron extraction. The combination should be excellent. The only uncertainty is whether PEI interferes with the PCBM-60/perovskite interface quality. Given PEI's proven track record, this should be top-tier. **~19-21%**

**2. c044** (PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + Cu):
- Near-identical to 18.8% training device (PCBM-60\|BCP + PTAA + PFN + Cu\|Ag). Without PFN interlayer but with pure Cu: very close to training data. BCP is the gold standard ETL modifier. PTAA + Cu is the best HTL/contact combination. **~18-19%**

**3. c079** (PCBM-60\|BCP + NiO-c\|SY1 + Ag):
- SDBS-modified NiO-c gave 19.04%. SY1 is likely a similar surface modifier. PCBM-60\|BCP is excellent. **~17-19%**

**4. c041** (PCBM-60\|BCP + NiMgLiO-c + Ag, FTO):
- NiMgLiO-c is a high-quality doped NiO HTL. PCBM-60\|BCP is the best ETL. Training analog (with TiO2-c instead of BCP) = 18.185%. BCP should be better than TiO2-c as modifier. **~17-19%**

**5. c085** (TTC\|C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag):
- C60\|BCP + PTAA + Ag = 17.17%. TTC (likely a silane SAM) passivates the perovskite surface before C60 deposition, reducing interface recombination. This is a well-known strategy. **~17-19%**
